notes: OWNER HARDWARE. Speaks OPOv1 over 079A per S4 capture (issue #5): handshake reply 8100 bitmap "00 9B 2C 50 80" (4-byte bitmap), 0x8200 offered events "02 01" only (wear, battery), sends no 0x8205 ack, no 0x0500 time request seen. DANGER: a long 0x010D feature query (23 ids) or burst of queries (010D,0106,0109,0105,010F) froze the buds ~6 s then dropped the link; "02 05 0D" / "05 06" status lists kept the link up (S4 [CAPTURE]/[TESTED]). Queries should be sent one at a time (no bit 56 batch 0x012F). EQ ids 0/1/2 = modeType 1/2/3 (S5 label Balanced (Default) / Deep Sea Bass / Bright & Crisp; S10 labels Classic / Dynamic bass / Clear vocals); official page says Bass Boost and Clear Vocals. No ANC/transparency per S5 and official page. S5 gesture masks: single 516, double 8805, triple 8801, hold 536 (decoded above via S10 table). Not stated by sources: wear detection id on this model, find, custom EQ. S5 flags: equalizer=2, clickTakePic, batteryInfo, fastDiscovery, related. Firmware min 4001250 / podsVersion 3007250 (S5).
